review: I like the look: each stage has its own colour, the ghost glows, and spikes, saws and lasers are easy to read. But First Steps left the mid player standing in front of a small spike patch for 45 seconds, and getting stuck on stage 1 would make me close the tab. Saw Mill killed a player after 2.1 seconds, which felt cheap for stage 3, and Gauntlet's laser wall at 67% stops most people. Crumble Bridge and Laser Gate felt fair and fun. Spring Loaded is pretty, but nobody died, so it had no tension. Ferry Lines has many pit deaths below the screen.
best: Crumble Bridge and Laser Gate are clear, fair and have just enough danger.
worst: Saw Mill kills you two seconds in, and First Steps can leave a player stuck in front of spikes on stage 1.
